title: A face-down Trap's borrowed lasting text stays dormant until it is revealed, as Siphon Squad's does
notes: R1487000: a face-down Trap's lasting text sleeps until it is revealed or face-up; R1487001: classify names a fused card's ingredients.

player.title: Face-down Traps keep borrowed effects asleep
changes: A lasting effect a Trap borrowed in a fusion waits while the Trap is face-down. Revealed or face-up it works, and the Trap still fires as a Trap.
